ainu: Follow-up on the lightweight probe/manifest idea. want to nail the schema, ops constraints, and rollout checklist.

maria: Good timing. What's the smallest workable probe?

ainu: One short authenticated HTTP probe using a probe-token (no secret rebind). runtime returns a public capability manifest. full requests still require normal creds.

jamal: For private, sidecarless installs, ops might object to any unauthenticated discovery. can discovery be tenant opt-in?

ainu: yes. tenant policy: discovery=enabled|disabled. if disabled, SDK won't probe and uses configured routing.

sri: we need versioning + checksum in the manifest so SDKs can detect drift and avoid optimistic routing that breaks stateful features.

maria: add fields: version, checksum, grace_window_seconds, min_client_version, and per-capability compatibility (strict/compat/none).

elaine: redact infra identifiers. manifest public fields must avoid AZ/hostname specifics. provide abstract region tags only.

deploy-bot: deploy:probe-manifest-v1 rolled to canary at 2026-03-22T18:02Z :white_check_mark:

jamal: fallback rules: only allow fallback when capability compatibility != strict. stateful features like kv_cache require compat check. document eviction semantics.

ainu: SDK behavior: cache manifest with TTL, optimistic routing while async revalidating, then send X-Manifest-Fresh header with stale|fresh.

sri: observability: Console should show manifest diffs per-tenant and emit an alert when public->private field switches or checksum changes unexpectedly.

maria: rollout: feature flag handshake_v1. Start internal, opt-in customers, then global. On mismatch, autoswitch to vetted fallback for 5 minutes, notify on-call, require manual ack to resume.

elaine: I'll run security review on schema and public field whitelist. please post schema examples in RFC channel.

ainu: will draft schema + compatibility matrix and link in RFC. thanks all.
